title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?
title_zh: A2Z GameSpec-Bench：编程智能体能多忠实地依据游戏设计规格生成游戏？
abstract_en: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.
abstract_zh: 将完整应用开发交给编程智能体，关键不只是生成看似合理的结果，还要忠实保留预期设计。游戏开发是检验这一能力的理想场景，因为长篇 Game Design Documents（GDDs）同时规定游戏逻辑、视觉渲染和玩家交互，并要求这些要素彼此协同。现有游戏开发基准通常依赖简短规格，难以评估长篇 GDDs 中跨方面的相互依赖需求。本文提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench，这是一个包含 100 份长篇 GDDs、用于评估智能体端到端游戏开发能力的基准。该基准通过检查游戏是否满足 GDD 要求及其关系来衡量忠实度，并将每份 GDD 转化为包含规则、约束和前置关系的依赖感知契约。评测结合源代码检查、智能体生成的测试策略、基于场景的回放和自适应试玩。契约在不同智能体和多轮修订中保持不变，从而支持一致比较与失败检测。实验表明，当前智能体难以同时满足代码实现与实际游玩中的相互依赖需求；经过两轮修订，针对具体需求的反馈相比自我修订使 GDD Fidelity 提升 10.9%。A2Z GameSpec-Bench 超越单纯实现评判，评估端到端规格遵循能力，并提供针对性反馈以促进更忠实的游戏开发。
key_points_zh: 提出包含100份长篇GDDs的A2Z GameSpec-Bench，面向端到端游戏开发评测。
将GDD转化为包含规则、约束和前置关系的依赖感知契约，以评估需求及其相互依赖关系是否被保留。
结合源代码检查、测试策略、场景回放和自适应试玩，避免仅依据实现结果判断游戏质量。
实验显示，当前编程智能体难以同时满足代码实现与实际游玩中的相互依赖需求。
针对需求的反馈经过两轮修订后，使GDD Fidelity相比自我修订提升10.9%。

llm_assessment.comment: This is a valuable coding-agent benchmark with dependency-aware contracts, replay-based testing, and requirement-specific feedback for iterative improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项有价值的编码Agent基准工作，结合了依赖感知契约、回放测试和面向需求的迭代反馈。
